server6_listen_port.description: DHCPv6 server port to listen on

server6_listen_interface.description: Interface to bind DHCPv6 server to (optional, empty = all interfaces)

server6_server_id_mac.description: MAC address for server_id DUID-LL (format: XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX)

server6_file_leases_path.description: Path to file containing static DHCPv6 leases

server6_dns_resolvers.description: List of IPv6 DNS resolvers to advertise

server6_nbp_url.description: URL to network boot program for NBP plugin

server6_prefix_delegation_prefix.description: IPv6 prefix pool for prefix delegation

server4_listen_port.description: DHCPv4 server port to listen on

server4_listen_interface.description: Interface to bind DHCPv4 server to (optional, empty = all interfaces)

server4_listen_address.description: Address to bind DHCPv4 server to (empty = wildcard 0.0.0.0)

server4_lease_time.description: Default lease duration for DHCPv4 (Go duration format, e.g., '3600s')

server4_server_id.description: IPv4 address to use as DHCP Server Identifier

server4_dns_resolvers.description: List of IPv4 DNS resolvers to advertise

server4_router.description: IPv4 address of default router to advertise

server4_netmask.description: Network mask to advertise to DHCPv4 clients

server4_range_lease_file.description: Path to file for persisting dynamic DHCPv4 leases

server4_range_start.description: First IP in dynamic lease range

server4_range_end.description: Last IP in dynamic lease range

server4_range_duration.description: Lease duration in dynamic range (Go duration format, e.g., '60s')

server4_static_route_dest.description: Destination network of static route (without CIDR)

server4_static_route_prefixlen.description: Prefix length (CIDR bits) of static route
